You have just started. Your assignment (recorded on the board as #3 for @mobile-tabs):

You are the mobile core tabs builder for the Kezza Agent Rewards app (Phase 3).

Workspace root: `/Users/ravi/.codex/.chatgpt-projects/g-p-6ae81da483248191a7e1c68af4392bce/kezza-agent-app 2`

## Context — read these first
- `.gsd/SPEC.md` (FR-6 mobile screens)
- `src/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx`
- `src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx`
- `src/app/(tabs)/patients.tsx`
- `src/app/(tabs)/payments.tsx`
- `src/app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx`
- `src/features/referrals/hooks.ts`
- `src/features/referrals/types.ts`
- `src/features/payments/hooks.ts`
- `src/features/wallet/hooks.ts`
- `src/features/wallet/types.ts`
- `src/constants/theme.ts`
- `src/components/StatusBadge.tsx`
- `src/components/Screen.tsx`
- `src/components/Button.tsx`
- `src/lib/format.ts`
- `src/lib/errors.ts`
- `docs/backend-integration.md`

## Your tasks (P3-T1 through P3-T6)

**P3-T1: (tabs)/_layout.tsx — Tab bar polish**
Four tabs: Home (house icon), Patients (person icon), Claims (document icon), Rewards (star/wallet icon).
Use Expo's built-in `Ionicons` or unicode labels if no icon lib is installed.
Add unread notification badge on Profile tab if applicable.
Tab labels: "Home", "Patients", "Claims", "Rewards".

**P3-T2: (tabs)/index.tsx — Home tab (already 112 lines, verify/extend)**
Verify these states all work:
- Loading (skeleton or spinner)
- Error with retry
- Empty state (no referrals yet, friendly message + CTA)
- Populated state (stats, cycle progress bar, recent referrals)
Confirm `formatRupees` helper handles 0 paise correctly. Add any missing states.

**P3-T3: (tabs)/patients.tsx — Patients tab (72 lines — extend significantly)**
Current file is thin. Build complete implementation:
- Pull-to-refresh
- Search bar (filter by patient name, referral ref)
- Status filter chips (All, New, In Progress, Converted, Not Converted, Closed)
- List of referral cards: patient name (masked phone), service, branch, date, status badge
- Loading state (skeleton cards or spinner)
- Empty state: "No referrals yet — add your first patient"
- Error state with retry
- Each card: Pressable → navigates to referral/[id]
- FAB or header button: "Add patient" → add-patient modal

**P3-T4: (tabs)/payments.tsx — Payments/Claims tab (43 lines — extend)**
Complete implementation:
- Pull-to-refresh
- Status filter: All, Submitted, Under Review, Needs Info, Approved, Rejected
- Payment claim cards: referral name, invoice ref, claimed amount, status badge, date
- All states: loading, empty ("Submit your first payment claim"), error
- Each card → payment-claim/[id]
- Quick action: "Add payment" button

**P3-T5: (tabs)/wallet.tsx — Rewards tab (49 lines — extend)**
Complete implementation:
- Points balance (large, prominent)
- Indicative value label: "Estimated value: ₹X (indicative — subject to approved policy)"
- Current cycle progress bar
- Cycle dates and eligible sales progress
- Ledger entry list: credit, settlement, reversal entries with date and amount
- Loading, empty ("No reward activity yet"), error states

**P3-T6: Hooks — fill in any missing query hooks**
In `features/referrals/hooks.ts`: ensure `useAgentReferrals()`, `useAgentDashboard()`, `useReferralDetail(id)` exist.
In `features/payments/hooks.ts`: ensure `usePaymentClaims()`, `usePaymentClaimDetail(id)` exist.
In `features/wallet/hooks.ts`: ensure `useWallet()` exists.
Check `features/referrals/types.ts`, `features/payments/types.ts`, `features/wallet/types.ts` match the API response shapes in `docs/backend-integration.md`. Add missing types.

## Standards
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- All states: loading, error, empty, populated
- Use existing theme and components
- DO NOT touch auth screens or backend files

## Commits
One commit per task: `git add -A` then `git commit -m "feat(mobile): P3-Tx description"`
Confirm: `git log -1 --oneline`

## When done
Post to @coordinator:
- Summary of what you built/extended
- Any TypeScript errors found
- `git log --oneline -6`
